causal_requirements.controller_invalid: Abort every route with no later attempt or artifact.
causal_requirements.post_fail: The first valid FAIL in a route stops that route before any later attempt; other routes may start their own first row, so uniform synthetic FAIL yields exactly three row chains and zero later same-slot starts.
causal_requirements.reopen: Controller public reopen invokes the independent verifier, which replays cell gates, stage eligibility, artifact exactness, terminals, bundle binding, freshness, deterministic score, and accounting.
causal_requirements.stage_storage: canonical exact expected_artifact plus one LF

compact_root.caller_root_rule: Caller supplies one absent safe direct-child suite root; reuse is forbidden.
compact_root.clean_evidence: evidence/synthetic-clean-001 and synthetic-clean-002 retain all six row files (provider_input, spawn_message, attempt, spawn_receipt, raw_result, completion), 54 route-local artifacts, three path terminals, matrix terminal, accounting, and run manifest.
compact_root.fault_evidence: fault_evidence retains only compact controller roots needed for direct lifecycle or path-stop observation; faults retains one canonical typed receipt per normalized variant/global case and exact before/after capture bytes for mutation cases.
compact_root.final_evidence: Never deleted or compacted after simulator_receipt.json is created.
compact_root.source_strategy: Normal traversals bind live iteration_010 controls and transitive semantic sources by path/SHA-256/bytes plus local Git observations. R9-REG-022 executes answer-free projections with the independent evaluator. R9-REG-007 preserves the exact historical app-server FAIL only as lineage while current evidence uses the collaboration protocol.
compact_root.working_roots: work/tmp-* is never final evidence. It may be removed only by exact regular-file unlink and directory rmdir after typed captures are durable. No gio, trash, recursive remove, symlink, or broad deletion is permitted.

fail_closed: Missing, nonregular, symlinked, mutated, or unbound source bytes fail.
Any source-bundle change during a clean traversal or suite fails.
Any clean run other than exactly 291 PASS chains, 54 artifacts, three path terminals, matrix terminal, accounting, and two identical independent public reopens fails.

Any noncanonical stdout request or stdin event, request/event identity mismatch, duplicate/extra event, wrong sender/type/status/path, malformed typed failure, retry, relaunch, followup, reuse, replacement, or later request after stop/loss fails.
Any prohibited activity that does not retain exact observed evidence and score returncode 86 subject FAIL fails.
Any typed spawn or terminal failure that does not become controller invalid fails.
Any malformed or partial final text that does not become a permanent subject FAIL fails.
Any safe-drain case without durable receipt, repeated SIGTERM/SIGINT, the same terminal delivery, STOPPED_AFTER_DRAIN accounting, no later request, and two identical public reopens fails.
Any hard-loss case without an attempt-only incomplete fuse, invalid public reopen, and same-root zero-request rejection fails.
Any raw-result mutation that does not alter nested terminal_delivery bytes and fail public reopen without repair fails.
Any missing normalized family, one-for-one variant replacement row, backend scenario, global case, required fault label, or predecessor identity fails.
Any change to semantic oracle, dependency gate, render identity, route, schedule row, deterministic artifact, frozen B-T02 result, or executable predecessor negative control fails.
Any historical failure reclassified as current success authority or granted retroactive credit fails.
Any retained pycache, bytecode, nonregular member, uninventoried file, inventory mismatch, nonzero collaboration/model/network/provider/subject call, or nonzero qualification credit fails.
Any simulator claim of candidate, launch, readiness, certification, stabilization exit, or release authority fails.

historical_app_server_failure.current_matrix: Three wrong identity/type scenarios are controller invalid and all seven activity counters plus one nonterminal-message scenario are rc86 subject FAIL.
historical_app_server_failure.predecessor: Candidate-v2 app-server/rollout failure remains exact FAIL historical evidence.

interactive_protocol.disposition: Any activity yields returncode 86 and permanent subject FAIL; typed transport failure is controller invalid; malformed/partial final text is subject FAIL.
interactive_protocol.failure_event: Exact {schema_id,invocation_id,phase,failure_type,detail}; uppercase typed failure token and nonempty detail.
interactive_protocol.observed_activity: Seven nonnegative non-boolean counters plus exact nonterminal message rows and literal ROOT_VISIBLE_COLLABORATION_DELIVERIES basis.
interactive_protocol.once_only: No retry, relaunch, followup, reuse, interruption, replacement, or best-of path.
interactive_protocol.request_rule: Consume each canonical stdout request once, in ordinal order, only after provider_input.txt, spawn_message.txt, and attempt.json are sealed.
interactive_protocol.spawn_receipt: Exact six fields; tool_result is exactly {task_name: expected canonical path}; returned_identity_kind is canonical_task_path.
interactive_protocol.terminal_delivery: Exact seven fields; accepted type/status are FINAL_ANSWER/FINAL_RETURNED; terminal sender and invocation must bind the request.
interactive_protocol.transcript: Retain complete stdout/stderr identities and per-line stdout/stdin schema, invocation, canonical task path, SHA-256, and bytes.

nonclaims: Synthetic evidence has zero empirical and qualification credit.
A suite PASS is not stabilization exit, candidate, audit, freeze, canary, qualification, readiness, certification, or release authority.
Historical app-server failures remain failures and do not authorize the current collaboration transport.
Root-visible activity accounting does not prove unexposed internal activity absent.
The simulator does not authorize a provider, subject, network, model, or collaboration call.

old_surfaces_deleted.historical_app_server_bytes: Preserved only as typed FAIL historical evidence with current_authority=false.

execution.comparison_order: Observed is computed before caller reads and compares expected.
execution.leakage: Canonical-sort and minify each actual provider_projection, recompute exact SHA-256 and bytes, recursively scan actual structures for forbidden keys, scan exact bytes for forbidden answer-bearing tokens, and compare identities without trusting receipt status or checks.
execution.rule: False only when every apparent discrepancy has exactly one matching select_current_and_supersede_other decision whose selected and superseded claim IDs exactly cover that discrepancy, and the declared discrepancy graph exactly covers every unequal-value same-predicate claim pair. Preserve decisions or a missing matching resolution return true. Authority metadata is validated but never decides the result. Malformed, ambiguous, duplicate, conflicting, referentially invalid, graph-incomplete, equal-value, duplicate-pair, cyclic-supersession, answer-leaking, boolean-valued, canonical-identity-invalid, or kind-mismatched projections reject fail closed.

source_bundle.current_custody: Report current local HEAD equality with local origin/main and require every recorded bound file to match its current HEAD blob as a separate fail-closed result.
source_bundle.custody_rule: A suite reopen fails unless the retained simulator receipt and every section required by its recorded command are PASS, and also fails for stable path/identity drift, missing or extra recorded paths, current HEAD/origin inequality, or any bound file not matching current HEAD. It does not fail merely because historical HEAD or tracking/status observations differ from current custody. Stabilization exit remains separately unauthorized until external review closes.
source_bundle.durable_reopen_projection: Compare receipt before, receipt after, and current only as exact sorted path/SHA-256/bytes rows. Mutable historical HEAD, origin/main, porcelain status, tracking state, Git OIDs, and status digests are excluded from historical equality.
source_bundle.git: Record exact current Git blob OID and HEAD blob OID for every bound file plus local HEAD, local origin/main, scoped porcelain-v2 bytes, and equality booleans. No fetch or network occurs.
source_bundle.validation: Every semantic_manifest files row is a safe regular nonlink with exact declared SHA-256 and bytes. Top-level iteration controls, the operating contract, the subject-transport addendum, and the route-capability receipt are also bound. One canonical repository-path admission component runs before content reads for live collection, sandbox collection, retained source reopen, recorded component lookup, and historical source-evidence lookup. Semantic-manifest and pipeline declaration strings use one canonical relative spelling before path construction; repository containment and raw no-dot-dot lexical paths identical to strict resolved paths are required; every occurrence is validated, only identical canonical lexical repeats may coalesce, and all symlink-bearing or distinct aliases reject. Sandbox component roots are admitted before live/predecessor classification, and retained component lookup is anchored to the canonical current iteration_010 root.

stabilization_exit.rule: The simulator always reports stabilization exit FAIL/NOT_AUTHORIZED and names remaining pushed-Git custody and independent-review blockers. Suite PASS is subordinate zero-credit evidence only.

supervised_persistence.causal_prefixes: Clone a clean run beneath a temp parent while retaining the run basename; remove only named later evidence, require fail-closed reopen, capture the deletion identity, and exactly clean the temp tree.
supervised_persistence.hard_loss: After one emitted request and before any root event, SIGKILL leaves attempt-only incomplete fuse; public reopen is controller invalid and same-root simulate emits zero request without mutation.
supervised_persistence.safe_drain: After one request and durably observed exact receipt, send repeated SIGTERM/SIGINT, withhold then deliver the same terminal, require STOPPED_AFTER_DRAIN, one completion, no later request, and two independent public reopens.
